name: Replace string status constants with an enum
prompt: order.py models order statuses as bare string constants (STATUS_NEW, STATUS_SHIPPED, STATUS_CANCELLED). Introduce an OrderStatus enum in a new module status.py with members NEW, SHIPPED, CANCELLED (values 'new', 'shipped', 'cancelled') and update order.py to use it in describe(). The tests in test_order.py verify the refactor.
